# sndwrks

> sndwrks is a live entertainment command center platform providing server hardware, software, and integrations for show control, routing, haze monitoring, and automation.

sndwrks local runs on dedicated server hardware and delivers a browser-based web app for configuring and controlling your show. It supports OSC, sACN, PSN, TCP/UDP routing, macros, haze watch, chat, and device management. The platform connects to sndwrks cloud for backups, licensing, and the AI assistant.

- [Home](https://docs.sndwrks.com/): sndwrks complete documentation — start here for quick links to hardware setup, software setup, products, guides, and reference.

## Products

- [Products Overview](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/overview): Top-level overview of sndwrks products with links to hardware and software quick starts and sndwrks local documentation.
- [sndwrks local](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/home): Introduction to the sndwrks local server product — links to server hardware and software sections.
- [Server Hardware: Getting Started](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/server-hardware/getting-started): Landing page for server hardware documentation with links to what it is and quick setup.
- [Server Hardware: What is it?](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/server-hardware/what-is-it): Overview of the sndwrks server hardware — power supplies, network ports (8x 2.5G or 2x 1G), peripherals, and its role as the physical center of a show.
- [Server Hardware: Quick Setup](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/server-hardware/quick-setup): Step-by-step unboxing, inspection, and power-on instructions for both the full server and smol variants.
- [Software: Getting Started](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/getting-started): Index of all software documentation pages — devices, router, macros, haze watch, chat, assistant, e-stop, utility, users, cloud, and settings.
- [Software: What is it?](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/what-is-it): High-level description of the sndwrks local web app — browser-based, runs on the server, supports show control functions.
- [Software: Quick Setup](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/quick-setup): Concise guide to getting the server app running — finding the IP, signing in, configuring network settings, and adding devices.
- [Software: Overview](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/overview): The dashboard landing page — live analytics tiles, device monitoring status, and pinnable macro shortcut buttons.
- [Software: Devices](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/devices): Add and manage network devices (consoles, processors, sensors, video routers) — manual entry, network scan, transport types, monitoring options, VNC, and connection state.
- [Software: Device Adoption](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/device-adoption): Pair a sndwrks sensor to the server using a setup code from the cloud app — covers the adoption flow, security rationale, and permissions.
- [Software: Device VNC](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/device-vnc): Open a remote desktop session for any VNC-enabled device directly in the browser — configuration, quality presets, and permission requirements.
- [Software: Router](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/router): Message routing matrix, sACN engine configuration (HTP/LTP/Priority/Backup merge modes), PSN crosspoint routing, and message history audit trail.
- [Software: Macros](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/macros): Node-based macro builder — triggers (OSC, sACN, server event, wall clock), commands (device, OSC, TCP, UDP, HTTP, email, system), inputs, outputs, and transformers (delay, rate limit, map, edge detect).
- [Software: ATEM SuperSource](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/atem-supersource): Visual drag-and-drop editor for Blackmagic ATEM SuperSource layouts — design four-box composites and fire them from a macro. Currently in preview.
- [Software: Haze Watch](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/haze-watch): Monitor PM2.5, temperature, humidity, and CO₂ from sensors; configure triggers and commands to maintain consistent atmospheric levels via OSC.
- [Software: Chat](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/chat): Show team chat with channels, message priorities (info/attention/urgent), speed buttons, OSC API integration, and per-account notification preferences.
- [Software: Assistant](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/assistant): AI chat panel that reads server configuration and proposes approved changes — supports devices and documentation queries. Currently in preview, requires cloud connection.
- [Software: Control Surfaces](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/control-surfaces): Stream Deck integration for physical show-floor control — fire macros, chat speed buttons, or e-stop from hardware keys. Currently in preview.
- [Software: E-Stop](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/e-stop): Emergency stop button available on every page — stops routing and haze watch triggers; configurable engage/disengage permissions, OSC API control, and startup state option.
- [Software: Utility](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/utility): Network scanner, event log, syslog viewer, live PSN monitor, and sACN monitor across universes 1–256.
- [Software: Users & Permissions](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/users-and-permissions): Account management, registration with magic code, per-section permission editor, templates (full/enable only/view only), and least-privilege guidance.
- [Software: Cloud](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/cloud): What the server sends to sndwrks cloud — heartbeat, events, snapshots, backups, monitoring, and assistant calls — plus subscription states and lapse behavior.
- [Software: Settings](https://docs.sndwrks.com/products/sndwrks-local/software/settings): All server configuration — power/reset, show info, e-stop startup, double-message protection, IP blocklist, network/VLAN setup, router ports, sACN, PSN, syslog, backup and restore, and ATEM mask.

## Guides

- [Using Code to Send OSC](https://docs.sndwrks.com/guides/using-code-to-send-osc): Python and Node.js scripts for sending OSC messages from the terminal — includes setup with pyenv/nvm and a practical macOS login-item example.
- [UDP vs TCP](https://docs.sndwrks.com/guides/udp-vs-tcp): Explains the difference between UDP and TCP for show control — when to use each, the three-way handshake, retransmission, and a cheat sheet for common scenarios.
- [Designing a Show Network](https://docs.sndwrks.com/guides/show-network-design): Broadway-scale show network design using VLANs — VLAN plan, virtual and physical spreadsheet layouts, tagged/untagged/trunk ports, and worked examples with diagrams.

## Reference

- [OSC API V1](https://docs.sndwrks.com/reference/osc-api-v1): Complete OSC command reference for sndwrks local — global commands (confetti, ping, e-stop), devices, router crosspoints, events, haze watch triggers, macros, and chat over UDP or SLIP-framed TCP.
- [AI Statement](https://docs.sndwrks.com/reference/ai-statement): Describes how sndwrks uses AI (primarily Claude) to assist with documentation generation, proofreading, and screenshot updates, with human review for correctness.
